what: The proposed --base-remote and --base-ref flags are only presence-checked, not value-validated, while sibling base-ref consumers reject unsupported characters.
scenario_or_breakage: An external/manual caller can pass an empty, whitespace, or option-looking base value; the generator then builds a misleading git revision or falls back to HEAD~1, despite the plan claiming those values are rejected.
suggested_fix: Add the same non-empty regex validation used by ci-status.sh and rebase-push.sh for BASE_REMOTE and BASE_REF before constructing the prompt, and add a small generator harness assertion for invalid values.
